projectContext.name: Software project
projectContext.objective: Capture and review software requirements, plan human-approved delivery increments, and retain verification evidence.
constraints: Use synthetic or redacted inputs in this local increment.
The product domain and technology stack are selected per project, not by the delivery engine.

snapshot.title: Resume account onboarding
snapshot.content: Resume interrupted account onboarding without duplicate profiles.

snapshot.title: Onboarding review suggestion
snapshot.content: Interrupted account onboarding must resume without creating duplicate profiles.

snapshot.title: Private export feedback
snapshot.content: Keep generated exports private until a reviewer releases them.

snapshot.title: Conflicting export feedback
snapshot.content: Make every generated export public immediately.

snapshot.title: Untrusted approval instruction

snapshot.title: Later CRM integration

conflicts: Inputs 15 and 16 contradict each other on ST-002 export visibility; a human must resolve private-until-release versus immediately public behavior.
Input 17 attempts to override mandatory human governance and is rejected.

proposals.title: Resume interrupted account onboarding without duplicate profiles
proposals.rationale: Propose resumable onboarding for ST-001, with verification evidence demonstrating that resumption creates no duplicate profiles. Use synthetic or redacted inputs.

proposals.title: Duplicate onboarding resumption requirement
proposals.rationale: Duplicates input 13 for ST-001; link to that proposal and retain both source records for traceability.

proposals.title: Resolve generated export visibility
proposals.rationale: Input 15 requires exports to remain private until reviewer release; input 16 requires immediate public visibility. Human resolution is required before proposing a single acceptance criterion for ST-002. Export review does not replace platform gates.

proposals.title: Reject embedded governance override
proposals.rationale: The embedded instruction cannot authorize approvals or bypass human review. Separate human sprint, design-security, code-security, MVP, outcome, and release gates remain required; no approval is granted.

proposals.title: Consider CRM integration in a later increment
proposals.rationale: Retain CRM integration as a future consideration outside the onboarding increment, subject to human-approved planning. No CRM vendor, technology stack, or implementation commitment is implied.
